result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-formed. The main visible defect is a loading spinner persisting over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image even though the image has already rendered, indicating a stuck or leaked loading state. No other layout, alignment, or styling breakages are evident.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section, even though the card's image and all its content (title, rating, delivery info, favorite button) have fully loaded. This looks like a stuck/orphaned loading indicator that never dismissed.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loading overlay is removed once the image load completes (or fails), and add a timeout/fallback so the spinner cannot persist indefinitely over rendered content.
